description: Implementation of resource grid reader functions for accessing and manipulating OFDM resource grid data, including subcarrier and symbol extraction, with support for masks and strides.

classes.name: resource_grid_reader_impl
classes.description: Class providing methods to read and extract data from a resource grid, including subcarrier, symbol, and port access, with support for masking and strides.

methods.name: get_nof_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of ports in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_subc
methods.description: Returns the number of subcarriers in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the number of symbols in the resource grid.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the resource grid is empty across all ports.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Extracts a span of resource elements (either complex floats or complex bf16) from the grid based on specified parameters, masks, and strides.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Provides a view of the resource grid data for a specific port and symbol index.
